cases.title: User journey examples
cases.description: Discover how different profiles use CIEL AVENUE for their real estate projects

buyer.name: Marie, 32 years old - Buyer
buyer.subtitle: First property purchase
buyer.day1: Creates her "Buyer" profile and enters her budget (€350,000), desired location (Paris 15th) and property type (3-room).
buyer.day2: Uploads her documents: payslips, tax notice, bank statements.
buyer.day3: Solvency score calculated: 8.5/10. Borrowing capacity validated.
buyer.day5: A certified broker contacts her to optimize her financing.

renovator.name: Thomas, 45 years old - Renovator
renovator.subtitle: Old house renovation project
renovator.day1: Creates his "Renovator" profile with his project: complete renovation of a 120m² house in Villeurbanne.
renovator.day2: Uploads work quotes and project plans. Estimated budget: €80,000.
renovator.day4: A certified project manager analyzes his project and offers support.
renovator.day7: Connected with qualified artisans for different trades.

expert.name: Sophie, 38 years old - Expert Surveyor
expert.subtitle: EPC certified professional
expert.registration: Creates her "Expert Surveyor" profile and uploads her EPC, asbestos, lead certifications.
expert.verification: Documents validated by the CIEL AVENUE team. Profile certified within 48h.
expert.leads: Receives requests from pre-verified clients with complete files.
expert.result: 156 missions completed via the platform in 1 year.
